data.one_liner: Flutter widget to embed customizable image cropping UI anywhere in your widget tree.
data.what_it_does: Provides a flexible Crop widget that can be placed anywhere on screen, allowing users to pan, zoom, crop with rectangles or circles, and fix aspect ratios. Controlled programmatically via a CropController with support for undo and redo operations.
use_when: You need a custom inline image cropping UI inside a screen, dialog, or bottom sheet.
You want full control over the surrounding layout and buttons for the cropping interface.
You need interactive panning, zooming, and aspect ratio fixing for images.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete out-of-the-box picker and cropper screen with pre-built control buttons.
You need to read or download image files directly from local storage or remote sources.
strengths: Flexible placement anywhere in the widget tree with minimal UI restrictions.
Includes a CropController for external control, undo, and redo features.
Supports customizable backend logic for format detection, parsing, and cropping.
weaknesses: Does not provide out-of-the-box UI control buttons; you must build your own buttons.
Does not handle image loading or file reading from storage or internet sources.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or build runner configuration required.
